w: Quorum where a church has four or more ruling elders
v: The pastor and two ruling elders

w: Quorum where a church has fewer than four ruling elders
v: The pastor and one ruling elder

v: Three ruling elders

w: Quorum with no pastor and fewer than five ruling elders
v: Two ruling elders

w: Stated meetings
v: At least quarterly, and whenever two ruling elders request it

w: Records to presbytery
v: At least once a year

w: Board of deacons meetings
v: At least once a quarter, and when the Session requests

w: Quorum

w: Stated meetings
v: At least twice a year

w: Call of a special meeting
v: Three teaching elders and three ruling elders from at least three churches, with ten days notice

w: A minister carried on the roll without a call
v: Not beyond three years before the procedure of 34-10 is followed

w: Notice before dissolving a church
v: At least sixty days

w: Make-up of a presbytery commission
v: At least two teaching elders and two ruling elders

w: Quorum
v: One hundred commissioners, half teaching elders and half ruling elders, from at least a third of the presbyteries

w: Call of a special meeting

v: At least six months, unless presbytery deems the case extraordinary

w: Internship

w: Licensure

w: Omitting an educational requirement or a part of the trials
v: Three-fourths approval of presbytery, with reasons recorded

w: Temporary supply relations
v: No longer than one year, renewable

w: Notice of a congregational meeting

v: A fourth up to 100 members, a fifth up to 300, a sixth up to 500, a seventh up to 700, and 100 members above that

w: Quorum of a congregational meeting

v: At least thirty days

w: Notice of a congregational meeting to elect officers

w: Request for a meeting to elect additional officers

v: Within sixty days, or members may complain

w: Confession of Faith and Catechisms
